tasks.todo-list: deno eval 'const html = await Deno.readTextFile("examples/05-todo-list/app/index.html"); console.log("Todo List: http://localhost:8003/"); Deno.serve({ port: 8003 }, (request) => new URL(request.url).pathname === "/" ? new Response(html, { headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } }) : new Response("Not found", { status: 404 }));'
tasks.typecheck: deno check src/cli.ts src/diagnostics.ts src/formatter.ts src/surface.ts examples/02-static-faq/app/server.ts examples/03-contact-viewer/app/server.ts examples/04-click-counter/app/server.ts test/surface_test.ts
tasks.verify: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno task typecheck && deno task test
